dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the Crow Tribe of Montana and water infrastructure development on the Crow Reservation.
dimensions.evidence: revises the water rights settlement agreement entered into by the Crow Tribe of Montana and Montana.

dimensions.assessment: Modifies financial accounts and project authorities for water production, treatment, and delivery infrastructure.
dimensions.evidence: plan, permit, design, engineer, construct, reconstruct, replace, rehabilitate, operate, or repair water production, treatment, or delivery infrastructure

dimensions.assessment: Establishes new implementation and project accounts for previously authorized settlement funds, while stating the federal government has no obligation for operation and maintenance costs.
dimensions.evidence: The Federal Government shall have no obligation to pay for the operation, maintenance, or replacement of any MR&I Project.

dimensions.assessment: Amends multiple sections of the Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Act of 2010 and the Claims Resolution Act of 2010.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Act of 2010 to make improvements to that Act

dimensions.assessment: Extends deadlines such as hydropower rights at Yellowtail Dam to 20 years, with permanent infrastructure title transfers to the Tribe.
dimensions.evidence: Title to, control over, and operation of any project constructed using funds from the MR&I Projects Account shall remain in the Tribe.

missing_information: Total dollar amounts to be deposited into the newly established MR&I Projects Account.
importance_detail.rationale: Revises the Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Act of 2010 by restructuring implementation accounts, establishing a new MR&I Projects Account, and extending hydropower construction rights.
